cfg.kineticbeacon.beacon.description: Server-authoritative beacon behavior. Both singleplayer and multiplayer read and save through the active server; editing requires permission level 2.
cfg.kineticbeacon.beacon.chunk.descripti: Controls whether beacons may keep surrounding chunks active and sets the radius for each beacon level.
cfg.kineticbeacon.beacon.chunk.tooltip: Allow active beacons to force-load chunks around themselves.
cfg.kineticbeacon.beacon.radii.tooltip: Four entries correspond to beacon levels 1-4. Radius 0 loads 1x1 chunks, 1 loads 3x3, and values are clamped from -1 to 16.
cfg.kineticbeacon.beacon.spawn.descripti: Controls global entity spawn interception inside protected beacon areas.
cfg.kineticbeacon.beacon.spawn_prevent.t: Prevent configured entity spawn types inside active beacon protection ranges.
cfg.kineticbeacon.beacon.spawn_whitelist: Entities in this list may spawn inside protected beacon areas.
cfg.kineticbeacon.beacon.spawn_blacklist: Entities in this list are always blocked inside protected beacon areas.
cfg.kineticbeacon.beacon.spawn_rules.too: One entry per line: entity ID; interception codes, for example minecraft:zombie;AE.
cfg.kineticbeacon.beacon.limits.descript: Limits the total number of unique chunks force-loaded globally and, optionally, per player.
cfg.kineticbeacon.beacon.global_limit.to: Maximum unique chunks force-loaded by all beacons across all dimensions.
cfg.kineticbeacon.beacon.per_player_enab: Also enforce a separate force-loaded chunk quota for each beacon owner.
cfg.kineticbeacon.beacon.per_player_limi: Maximum unique chunks assigned to one player; values above the global limit are reduced when saved.
cfg.kineticbeacon.beacon.offline.descrip: Selects what beacon functions stop after their owner has remained offline for the configured duration.
cfg.kineticbeacon.beacon.offline_timeout: Minutes after logout before offline actions apply. 0 is immediate and -1 disables the timeout.
cfg.kineticbeacon.beacon.offline_deactiv: Deactivate the beacon light and effects completely after its owner times out.
cfg.kineticbeacon.beacon.offline_cl.tool: Stop this owner's beacon chunk loading after the timeout.
cfg.kineticbeacon.beacon.offline_sp.tool: Stop this owner's beacon spawn prevention after the timeout.
gui.kineticbeacon.beacon.chunk_load.desc: When enabled, this beacon will keep chunks within its radius loaded.
gui.kineticbeacon.beacon.spawn_prevent.d: When enabled, hostile mobs will be prevented from spawning within the beacon's radius.
gui.kineticbeacon.beacon.cl_rad.desc:
